key_facts: Project: BotDeEncuestas — AI-powered Telegram quiz generator for Spanish learners
Stack: Python 3.10+ / aiogram 3.x / aiosqlite / httpx / pydantic-settings / Hatchling / uv
Entry point: bot/main.py → main() → asyncio.run(_async_main()) — registered as console_scripts bot
AI provider: OpenCode Zen API at https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions (model: nemotron-3.5-lightning-free)
AI integration: bot/services/ai_service.py — AIService class, direct HTTP via httpx (NOT using opencode CLI)
Headers: x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-opencode-request, User-Agent: opencode/1.18.15
No Authorization header or API key required — client identification headers only
Config: bot/config.py — pydantic-settings, reads .env (BOT_TOKEN, WHITELIST_USERNAMES, DATABASE_PATH, PROXY_URL)
No opencode.json or .opencode/ exists in project root — no CLI integration configured
Proxy: aiohttp-socks for Telegram API, httpx proxy passthrough for AI calls via active_proxy_url global
Database: SQLite via aiosqlite — 3 tables: users, surveys, bot_config
FSM: 14 states in SurveyCreation StatesGroup for multi-step quiz flow
Handlers: start.py, survey.py (1304 lines, main flow), callbacks.py
Services: ai_service.py (631 lines), job_registry.py (in-memory task tracker)
call_chains: main.py:main → _async_main → init_db → Bot → Dispatcher → routers → handlers
blast_radius: bot/services/ai_service.py — primary file for opencode integration change
bot/config.py — would need new env vars for CLI mode
bot/main.py — entry point, would need CLI mode branching
pyproject.toml — new console_scripts entry for CLI

data.for_supervisor: VERDICT: The project uses OpenCode ONLY as an external AI API endpoint (HTTP POST to opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions) via direct httpx calls in ai_service.py. There is NO opencode CLI integration, NO opencode.json, NO .opencode/ directory. The AIService class hardcodes the API URL, model name, and client-identification headers. All 5 AI operations go through _call_api → httpx.post. For CLI integration, the key change point is bot/services/ai_service.py (replace httpx calls with subprocess/CLI) and bot/config.py (add CLI mode settings).
